items.title_en: Indian man in Canada gave up desi food to get into ‘best shape’ of his life
items.title_zh: 加拿大的印度男子为了达到一生中“最好的身材”而放弃了印度美食
items.summary_en: In an Instagram video, Singh explained how changing his eating habits helped him manage his meals, protein intake and workout routine.
items.summary_zh: 在 Instagram 视频中，辛格解释了改变饮食习惯如何帮助他管理膳食、蛋白质摄入量和日常锻炼。

items.title_en: Top 10 countries for travel and tourism: Japan knocks US off top spot in WEF tourism index
items.title_zh: 旅行和旅游排名前十的国家：日本在世界经济论坛旅游指数中取代美国位居榜首
items.summary_en: Japan ranked No. 1 in the Travel and Tourism index released by World Economic Forum
items.summary_zh: 日本在世界经济论坛发布的旅行和旅游指数中排名第一

items.title_en: ‘Promote him’: Internet praises cop who clung to smugglers’ car roof for 40 km
items.title_zh: “提拔他”：网络赞扬抓着走私者车顶40公里的警察
items.summary_en: A viral video shared by Tamil Nadu Police shows Constable M Velmurugan clinging to the roof of a speeding car for 40 km to intercept suspected contraband smugglers in Coimbatore. Following the pursuit, social media users are widely demanding an instant promotion for his bravery.
items.summary_zh: 泰米尔纳德邦警方分享的一段病毒视频显示，哥印拜陀警员 M Velmurugan 紧贴一辆超速行驶的汽车车顶行驶 40 公里，拦截涉嫌走私的人。在追捕之后，社交媒体用户普遍要求立即宣传他的勇敢行为。

items.title_en: Bengaluru traffic: Residents wait 30 minutes just to exit their own apartment complex
items.title_zh: 班加罗尔交通：居民要等30分钟才能离开自己的公寓大楼
items.summary_en: A viral Bengaluru video shows vehicles queued inside and outside a residential society, with the creator claiming residents waited up to 30 minutes to exit.
items.summary_zh: 一段在班加罗尔疯传的视频显示，车辆在住宅小区内外排队，视频制作者声称居民等待长达 30 分钟才能离开。

items.title_en: Man dressed as Batman scales towering wall to return stolen purse on night out
items.title_zh: 男子装扮成蝙蝠侠爬上高墙，晚上外出归还被盗钱包
items.summary_en: A fancy-dress night out in Norwich, UK took an unexpectedly heroic turn when a group of costumed revellers dressed as comic book icons sprinted into action to chase down an opportunistic thief and retrieve a stolen handbag. Sonni Mason, a 25-year-old cafe worker and creative from London, was celebrating a friend’s birthday on Saturday night while outfitted head-to-toe in an authentic Batman suit. The evening shifted from a standard weekend celebration into real-life crime-fighting when Mason witnessed a woman’s…
items.summary_zh: 英国诺威奇的一个化装舞会之夜发生了意想不到的英雄转变，一群盛装打扮成漫画人物的狂欢者冲刺起来，追捕一个投机取巧的小偷并找回被盗的手提包。周六晚上，来自伦敦的 25 岁咖啡馆工作人员兼创意人士索尼·梅森 (Sonni Mason) 从头到脚都穿着正宗的蝙蝠侠套装，正在庆祝一位朋友的生日。当晚从标准的周末庆祝活动变成了现实生活中的犯罪图
